meta.title: feat: replace SQLite with DuckDB
meta.body_summary: Replace SQLite with DuckDB as the default database for raglite to enable HNSW vector search, BM25 full-text search, and easier extension management.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex drafted a large DuckDB replacement PR; human reviewer asked minor questions and gave LGTM; merged after 1.7 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 771 changed lines across 17 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. It swaps the database backend from SQLite to DuckDB, a significant architectural change, and the successful merge suggests the change was well scoped and accepted.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot flagged the DuckDB distance function map missing the l1 metric, and the VSS index creation metrics missing l1; human reviewer questioned the [0] indexing addition in query adapter, which the author clarified as a type signature fix.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved vector search performance via DuckDB's HNSW index and BM25 full-text search, enabling efficient search on larger document sets (beyond 1M chunks).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Replacing the entire database backend (SQLite → DuckDB) required deep integration with DuckDB extensions, SQLAlchemy dialect, and index management; the agent was able to produce a functional PR that was accepted after minor corrections.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot identified missing l1 metric in distance compilation and index creation; human reviewer questioned an indexing change in query adapter.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR includes unit tests for DuckDB engine creation and search, but no before/after performance benchmarks or profiling data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions noted; the change was additive and backward compatible with an environment variable to toggle, but no revert.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced SQLite database backend with DuckDB for keyword and vector search. Updated _typing.py to use SQLAlchemy FunctionElement for distance computation, added DuckDB-specific compilations. Modified _database.py to install FTS/VSS extensions, create HNSW index with VSS, and manage FTS index updates. Adjusted _search.py to use DuckDB BM25 for keyword search and unified vector search. Updated tests, config default, and dependencies.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most other files are documentation updates, test modifications, and dependency adjustments to support DuckDB.
change_trajectory: Initial commit switched from sqlite to duckdb, refactoring database engine creation and search.
Subsequent commits fixed dependency versions, DuckDB integration bugs, updated FTS index on creation, added tests, addressed Copilot review comments, and made cosmetic documentation adjustments.

review_signals.summary: DuckDB func_map missing l1 metric; suggested adding array_l1_distance.
DuckDB VSS index metrics dict missing l1; suggested adding l1.
docstring still mentions only PostgreSQL, not DuckDB.
Questioned the addition of [0] index in embed_strings result; author explained it's due to type signature change.
Said complex PR, LGTM, asked if it was manually tested; author replied testing only via automated tests.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened as draft with initial DuckDB switch, then marked ready for review after several fixup commits.
Copilot bot reviewed and left inline suggestions about missing l1 metric and outdated docstring; author acknowledged with 'improve later'.
Human reviewer ThomasDelsart inspected code, questioned a [0] index change in query adapter, and subsequently commented LGTM after clarifications.
Author confirmed no manual testing beyond automated tests; reviewer accepted and PR was merged.
